metadata.name: Iron Tide
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: An amphibious assault ship riding at anchor on a black sea at night. The Boarders start on the floating dock off the stern with speeders, a hovercraft and a dropship: up the stern gate into the flooded well deck and the vehicle hangar, up the cargo lifts or the side ladders onto the flight deck, or fly in. The Crew hold the ship: long passageways under the hangar galleries, the engine room and its catwalks, berthing, the mess and galley, the brig, and the island with its bridge and radar deck. Hostages wait in the brig; bomb sites in the engine room and on the bridge; flags at the bow and the stern dock.
